
{{alias}}( y, p )
    Computes the log loss.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `y` is not +1 or -1, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Log loss.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 0.782 )
    ~0.377
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 0.202 )
    ~0.597
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, -0.999 )
    ~1.313
    > v = {{alias}}( -1.0, 0.2 )
    ~0.798
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
